gloomwing_hunt_00.title: 1/30: The Commissioner's Black Ledger
gloomwing_hunt_00.kicker: The Hunt for the Gloomwing · personal ambition
gloomwing_hunt_00.text: The Bureau offers four million Lumens for a creature nobody can describe consistently. A clerk presents three contracts, each already signed in handwriting distressingly like yours. Pell’s street counter beside the Lantern Quay infirmary handles supplementary claims; you may return there between stages of the hunt.

choices.label: Read the casualty register
choices.success: A survey of the claimants reveals that each vanished after hearing the same bell. You set a fact down where another person may find it.
choices.failure: The evidence twists away before you can secure it. The hunt has not advanced; you can try another approach.

choices.label: Bind yourself to the hunter's oath
choices.success: A survey of the claimants reveals that each vanished after hearing the same bell. The cost is real, but you leave the chamber unbowed.
choices.failure: You endure the encounter, but not without a cost. The hunt has not advanced; you can try another approach.

choices.label: Question the clerk about missing pages
choices.success: A survey of the claimants reveals that each vanished after hearing the same bell. You gain a witness who will remember which way you chose.
choices.failure: Your proposal falls on ears still loyal to the Bureau. The hunt has not advanced; you can try another approach.
